text: {"name": "rf_write_cal_param_msg_handler", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Handles an RF calibration message (logged as assoc_rsp_handler) by buffering payload fragments into a global RF context and invoking rf_write_cal_param when the message event/completion field is zero.", "subsystem": "rf", "var_renames": {"a1": "msg", "v2": "rf_ctx_base", "v3": "msg_command_or_len", "v4": "event_completion_field", "v5": "rf_ctx_write_offset", "v6": "copy_len", "v7": "payload_src", "v8": "payload_dst_base", "v10": "payload_byte"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 0, "meaning": "message u16 command/length selector: values <=5 take the no-copy path, values >6 yield copy_len = field - 6"}, {"offset": 14, "meaning": "message u16 event/completion field: zero triggers rf_write_cal_param, nonzero is passed to event_dispatch_1"}, {"offset": 16, "meaning": "message u16 RF calibration parameter, masked with 0x3FFF before being passed to rf_write_cal_param"}, {"offset": 18, "meaning": "message payload byte area copied into the RF calibration context"}]}
